name: todoist
description: Todoist integration — list and manage tasks and projects: list tasks (optionally by project or filter), list projects, add tasks, complete tasks, and update tasks via the Todoist REST API v2.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: Copy your API token from Todoist Settings > Integrations > Developer

tools.name: todoist.list_tasks
tools.description: List active tasks, optionally filtered by project or a Todoist filter query.

projectId.description: Only return tasks in this project id

filter.description: Todoist filter query, e.g. 'today | overdue' or 'p1 & #Work'

tools.name: todoist.list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the account.

content.description: Task content (the task text; supports Markdown)

projectId.description: Project id to add the task to (defaults to Inbox)

dueString.description: Human-readable due date, e.g. 'tomorrow at 4pm' or 'every Monday'

tools.name: todoist.complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete (closes it).

taskId.description: Id of the task to complete

tools.name: todoist.update_task
tools.description: Update an existing task's content, due date, priority, or description.

taskId.description: Id of the task to update

dueString.description: New human-readable due date, e.g. 'next Friday'
